events.title: Japanese Swordsmith Steam page is now live
events.summary: From tamahagane to a finished katana.Japanese Swordsmith is now Coming Soon on Steam.Become a swordsmith in Bakumatsu Kyoto—sumikiri, mizuheshi, folding forge, the quench, polishing—and finish a Japanese sword with your own hands. A hardcore swordsmith simulator. It will not be easy.Wishlist so you don’t miss Early Access and the Steam Next Fest demo later: Community: https://discord.gg/feESU6cSk7The path of the swordsmith is long and steep.Can you forge a blade worthy of history?
